text:
maria: Heads-up, deploy-bot paused the payments rollout during canary. 1/4 canary pods failing preUpgrade hook in the subchart (payment-migrations). Logs show missing secret keys after the new chart reordered hooks. Can anyone look?

deploy-bot: Canary pause triggered: preUpgradeHookFailed for release payments-2026-03. Pausing further promotion and marking release as quarantine. See deploy action id: db-rls-8921.

jamal: On it. Quick repro from the canary node shows init container exits with 1 and the hook pod logs: 
```
Error: secret "payments-credentials" not found
at preUpgrade /charts/payment-migrations/templates/hook.yaml:12
```
This smells like subchart install ordering changed between chart v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 (subchart was bumped to v1.5.0).

leo: Oof. That change landed in yesterday's chart bump. CI didn't catch ordering because kubeapply allowed concurrent creation. We should avoid hotpatching the hook, instead either pin subchart to v1.4.2 for this release or skip the hook until we patch ordering. Which do we prefer? :thinking_face:

maria: Prefer pin for immediate unblocking. We need to be careful with DB migrations — if we pin we must ensure the migration hook doesn't run twice. Suggest manual canary rollback to image-tag at 20260320-rc5 and pin chart dependency to v1.4.2. Then re-run canary.

jamal: Agreed. Commands I'm going to run on the canary namespace: 
```
# pin dependency and trigger helm upgrade (no migration hook)
helm dependency update charts/payments --set payment-migrations.enabled=false
helm upgrade payments charts/payments --namespace canary --reuse-values --set image.tag=20260320-rc5 --set payments.subchart.version=1.4.2
```
I'll annotate the release with: "manual-unblock: pinned-subchart-for-canary"

leo: Quick note for release notes: call out the subchart ordering regression and the temporary pin. Add a follow-up ticket to fix hook ordering and add e2e that validates preUpgrade hooks in parallel installs.

sre-oncall: If jamal pins, add a manual rollback plan in case the pin leaves the prod promotion in a weird state. Plan: if we see db migration pending in prod, revert chart to v3.1.9 and run migrations from maintenance job. I'll standby for the promote command.

maria: Thanks. jamal, after you pin and canary stabilizes, hold the promotion until we get a thumbs-up here. Also open a short PR that reverts the subchart bump in the release branch so the deploy bot won't auto-promote the bumped chart later.

jamal: Understood, running now. I'll post results and the deploy-bot event id.

deploy-bot: Action db-rls-8921 updated: canary manually modified (pin applied) by jamal. Canary status: 3/4 healthy, preUpgrade hook disabled for canary. Promotion will remain paused until manual resume.

maria: OK — leaving this thread open until prod promotion is cleared. I'll draft the release note snippet: "Hotfix: temporary pin of payment-migrations subchart to v1.4.2 due to preUpgrade hook ordering regression; follow-up fix and e2e added (ticket INF-3145)." :memo:
